This notebook builds a **merged binary dataset** from multiple GEO studies and compares **weighted vs unweighted** models using repeated CV.

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
```

## Dataset registry + merge helpers

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
datasets_multiclass <- c("GSE25066")          # PAM50 multiclass (example; not merged yet)
datasets_binary <- c("GSE15852", "GSE54002")  # Binary Normal vs Cancer (merged below)

normal_keywords <- c(
  "normal", "non-tumor", "nontumor", "non tumour", "nontumour",
  "healthy", "control", "adjacent normal", "benign"
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
load_geo_eset <- function(gse_id) {
  g <- GEOquery::getGEO(gse_id)
  if (inherits(g, "ExpressionSet")) return(g)
  if (is.list(g) && length(g) >= 1) return(g[[1]])
  stop("Could not load ExpressionSet for ", gse_id)
}

clean_first_symbol <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || trimws(as.character(s)) == "") return(NA_character_)
  s <- trimws(as.character(s))
  parts <- strsplit(s, " /// ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  trimws(parts[1])
}

collapse_to_genes <- function(eset) {
  e <- exprs(eset)
  fd <- fData(eset)
  sym_col <- grep("gene\\s*symbol|symbol", colnames(fd), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  gene_sym_raw <- if (!is.na(sym_col)) as.character(fd[, sym_col]) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(fd))
has_symbol <- !is.na(gene_sym_raw) & trimws(gene_sym_raw) != ""
gene_sym <- rep(NA_character_, length(gene_sym_raw))
gene_sym[has_symbol] <- vapply(gene_sym_raw[has_symbol], clean_first_symbol, character(1))
  gene_sym <- ifelse(is.na(gene_sym) | gene_sym == "", rownames(e), gene_sym)
  e_g <- limma::avereps(e, ID = gene_sym)

  # Feature table: keep one row per gene symbol where possible, otherwise minimal table
  fd$.__gene_sym__ <- gene_sym
  fd_g <- fd %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(.__gene_sym__ = fd$.__gene_sym__) %>%
    group_by(.__gene_sym__) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(".__gene_sym__")

  list(eMat_g = e_g, fMat_g = fd_g, pMat = pData(eset))
}

infer_binary_label <- function(pMat, normal_keywords) {
  # Prefer characteristics_ch* columns first, then everything else
  cols_char <- grep("^characteristics_ch", colnames(pMat), value = TRUE)
  cols_other <- setdiff(colnames(pMat), cols_char)
  cols_try <- c(cols_char, cols_other)

  has_kw <- function(x) {
    x <- tolower(as.character(x))
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    any(vapply(
      normal_keywords,
      function(kw) any(grepl(kw, x, fixed = TRUE)),
      logical(1)
    ))
  }

  for (cn in cols_try) {
    x <- pMat[[cn]]
    if (!has_kw(x)) next
    xlow <- tolower(as.character(x))
    xlow[is.na(xlow)] <- ""
    is_normal <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(normal_keywords, function(kw) grepl(kw, xlow, fixed = TRUE)))
    label <- ifelse(is_normal, "Normal", "Cancer")
    label[xlow == ""] <- NA_character_
    label <- factor(label, levels = c("Cancer", "Normal"))
    tab <- table(label, useNA = "no")
    if (length(tab) >= 2 && all(tab > 0)) {
      return(list(label = label, label_col = cn))
    }
  }

  list(label = factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(pMat)), levels = c("Cancer", "Normal")),
       label_col = NA_character_)
}

extract_after_scalar <- function(x, prefix) {
  # scalar-safe extractor for strings like "pam50_class: Basal"
  if (length(x) > 1) x <- x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  x <- as.character(x)
  m <- regexpr(prefix, x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (m[1] == -1) return(NA_character_)
  out <- substring(x, m[1] + attr(m, "match.length"))
  trimws(out)
}

infer_multiclass_label <- function(pMat) {
  cols_char <- grep("^characteristics_ch", colnames(pMat), value = TRUE)
  cols_other <- setdiff(colnames(pMat), cols_char)
  cols_try <- c(cols_char, cols_other)

  # Prefer columns that look like PAM50
  cols_try <- c(
    intersect(cols_try, grep("pam50", cols_try, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)),
    setdiff(cols_try, grep("pam50", cols_try, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE))
  )

  for (cn in cols_try) {
    x <- as.character(pMat[[cn]])
    # If entries contain "pam50_class:" parse after it; else use raw
    has_pam50_tag <- any(grepl("pam50_class:", x, ignore.case = TRUE))
    lab <- if (has_pam50_tag) {
      vapply(x, extract_after_scalar, character(1), prefix = "pam50_class:\\s*")
    } else {
      x
    }
    lab <- trimws(lab)
    lab[lab == ""] <- NA_character_
    y <- factor(lab)
    y <- droplevels(y[!is.na(y)])
    # Accept if 2+ levels and not degenerate
    if (nlevels(y) >= 2) {
      return(list(label = factor(lab), label_col = cn, parsed_pam50 = has_pam50_tag))
    }
  }

  list(label = factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(pMat))), label_col = NA_character_, parsed_pam50 = FALSE)
}

rbind_fill <- function(dfs) {
  all_cols <- Reduce(union, lapply(dfs, colnames))
  dfs2 <- lapply(dfs, function(d) {
    miss <- setdiff(all_cols, colnames(d))
    for (m in miss) d[[m]] <- NA
    d[, all_cols, drop = FALSE]
  })
  do.call(rbind, dfs2)
}

# Missing-value handling for merged expression matrices (use training-fold stats only)
impute_fit <- function(X_train) {
  meds <- apply(X_train, 2, function(v) stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  meds[is.na(meds)] <- 0
  list(median = meds)
}
impute_apply <- function(X, fit) {
  X2 <- X
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X2))) {
    idx <- is.na(X2[, j])
    if (any(idx)) X2[idx, j] <- fit$median[j]
  }
  X2
}
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
build_merged_binary_dataset <- function(gse_ids, normal_keywords) {
  pieces <- lapply(gse_ids, function(id) {
    eset <- load_geo_eset(id)
    cc <- collapse_to_genes(eset)
    lab <- infer_binary_label(cc$pMat, normal_keywords)

    p <- cc$pMat
    p$dataset_id <- id
    p$label_col_detected <- lab$label_col
    p$label_binary <- as.character(lab$label)

    list(id = id, e = cc$eMat_g, p = p, f = cc$fMat_g)
  })

  # Merge expression by UNION of genes; pad missing genes with NA
  all_genes <- Reduce(union, lapply(pieces, function(x) rownames(x$e)))
  if (length(all_genes) == 0) stop("No genes found across binary datasets.")

  pad_to_all_genes <- function(e, all_genes) {
    miss <- setdiff(all_genes, rownames(e))
    if (length(miss) > 0) {
      pad <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(miss), ncol = ncol(e),
                    dimnames = list(miss, colnames(e)))
      e <- rbind(e, pad)
    }
    e[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  e_big <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pieces, function(x) pad_to_all_genes(x$e, all_genes)))

  # Merge phenotype by union of columns
  p_big <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, `[[`, "p"))

  # Merge feature data by union of gene rows (keep only genes present in e_big)
  f_big_all <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, function(x) {
    ff <- x$f
    ff$dataset_id <- x$id
    tibble::rownames_to_column(ff, var = "gene_id")
  }))
  # Keep one row per gene_id (prefer the first dataset that has it)
  f_big <- f_big_all %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% rownames(e_big)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id")

  list(eMat = e_big, pMat = p_big, fMat = f_big, all_genes = all_genes, pieces = pieces)
}

build_merged_multiclass_dataset <- function(gse_ids) {
  pieces <- lapply(gse_ids, function(id) {
    eset <- load_geo_eset(id)
    cc <- collapse_to_genes(eset)
    lab <- infer_multiclass_label(cc$pMat)

    p <- cc$pMat
    p$dataset_id <- id
    p$label_col_detected <- lab$label_col
    p$label_multiclass <- as.character(lab$label)

    list(id = id, e = cc$eMat_g, p = p, f = cc$fMat_g)
  })

  all_genes <- Reduce(union, lapply(pieces, function(x) rownames(x$e)))
  if (length(all_genes) == 0) stop("No genes found across multiclass datasets.")

  pad_to_all_genes <- function(e, all_genes) {
    miss <- setdiff(all_genes, rownames(e))
    if (length(miss) > 0) {
      pad <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(miss), ncol = ncol(e),
                    dimnames = list(miss, colnames(e)))
      e <- rbind(e, pad)
    }
    e[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  e_big <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pieces, function(x) pad_to_all_genes(x$e, all_genes)))
  p_big <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, `[[`, "p"))

  f_big_all <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, function(x) {
    ff <- x$f
    ff$dataset_id <- x$id
    tibble::rownames_to_column(ff, var = "gene_id")
  }))
  f_big <- f_big_all %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% rownames(e_big)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id")

  list(eMat = e_big, pMat = p_big, fMat = f_big, all_genes = all_genes, pieces = pieces)
}

merged_bin <- build_merged_binary_dataset(datasets_binary, normal_keywords)
eMat_big_bin <- merged_bin$eMat
pMat_big_bin <- merged_bin$pMat
```

## Multiclass modelling (merged dataset)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
macro_f1 <- function(truth, pred) {
  truth <- factor(truth)
  pred <- factor(pred, levels = levels(truth))
  lvls <- levels(truth)
  f1s <- c()
  for (k in lvls) {
    tp <- sum(pred == k & truth == k, na.rm = TRUE)
    fp <- sum(pred == k & truth != k, na.rm = TRUE)
    fn <- sum(pred != k & truth == k, na.rm = TRUE)
    prec <- if ((tp + fp) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fp)
    rec  <- if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn)
    f1   <- if (is.na(prec) || is.na(rec) || (prec + rec) == 0) NA_real_ else 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec)
    f1s <- c(f1s, f1)
  }
  mean(f1s, na.rm = TRUE)
}

select_genes_one_vs_rest <- function(eMat_g, y, n_per_class = 25) {
  ok <- !is.na(y) & y != ""
  e <- eMat_g[, ok, drop = FALSE]
  y <- factor(y[ok])

  lvls_orig <- levels(y)
  lvls_safe <- make.names(lvls_orig)
  names(lvls_safe) <- lvls_orig

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + y)
  colnames(design) <- lvls_safe[lvls_orig]
  fit <- lmFit(e, design)

  genes <- character(0)
  for (lvl in lvls_orig) {
    others <- setdiff(lvls_orig, lvl)
    if (length(others) == 0) next
    lvl_s <- unname(lvls_safe[lvl])
    others_s <- unname(lvls_safe[others])
    contrast_str <- paste0(lvl_s, " - (", paste0(others_s, collapse = " + "), ")/", length(others_s))
    cont <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_str, levels = design)
    fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont)
    fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
    tt <- topTable(fit2, n = n_per_class, sort.by = "P")
    genes <- union(genes, rownames(tt))
  }
  genes
}
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
run_repeated_cv_multiclass <- function(X, y, K = 5, repeats = 10) {
  y <- factor(y)
  n <- nrow(X)
  perf <- data.frame()
  all_preds <- data.frame()

  has_multinom <- requireNamespace("nnet", quietly = TRUE)

  for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
    folds <- cvTools::cvFolds(n, K)
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      test_id <- folds$subsets[folds$which == k]
      train_id <- setdiff(seq_len(n), test_id)

      X_train <- X[train_id, , drop = FALSE]
      X_test  <- X[test_id, , drop = FALSE]
      y_train <- y[train_id]
      y_test  <- y[test_id]

      imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
      X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
      X_test_i  <- impute_apply(X_test, imp)

      sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
      X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
      X_test_s  <- standardize_apply(X_test_i, sc)

      # kNN
      pred_knn <- class::knn(train = X_train_s, test = X_test_s, cl = y_train, k = 7)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k,
                                     accuracy=mean(pred_knn == y_test),
                                     macro_f1=macro_f1(y_test, pred_knn)))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_knn))

      # SVM
      svm_fit <- e1071::svm(x = X_train_s, y = y_train, kernel = "radial", cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_train_s))
      pred_svm <- predict(svm_fit, X_test_s)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="SVM_RBF", rep=r, fold=k,
                                     accuracy=mean(pred_svm == y_test),
                                     macro_f1=macro_f1(y_test, pred_svm)))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="SVM_RBF", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_svm))

      # RF (use imputed, not scaled)
      rf_fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_train_i, y = y_train)
      pred_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="RF", rep=r, fold=k,
                                     accuracy=mean(pred_rf == y_test),
                                     macro_f1=macro_f1(y_test, pred_rf)))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="RF", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_rf))

      if (has_multinom) {
        mn_fit <- nnet::multinom(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s),
                                 trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 50000)
        pred_mn <- predict(mn_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s))
        perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="Multinom", rep=r, fold=k,
                                       accuracy=mean(pred_mn == y_test),
                                       macro_f1=macro_f1(y_test, pred_mn)))
        all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="multiclass", model="Multinom", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_mn))
      }
    }
  }

  list(perf = perf, preds = all_preds)
}

res_mc <- run_repeated_cv_multiclass(X_mc, y_mc, K = 5, repeats = 10)
```

## Model zoo + repeated CV (binary: merged datasets)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
make_stratified_folds <- function(y, K = 4) {
  y <- factor(y)
  folds <- vector("list", K)
  idx_by_class <- split(seq_along(y), y)
  for (cl in names(idx_by_class)) {
    idx <- sample(idx_by_class[[cl]])
    groups <- split(idx, rep(1:K, length.out = length(idx)))
    for (k in seq_len(K)) folds[[k]] <- c(folds[[k]], groups[[k]])
  }
  lapply(folds, sort)
}

auc_roc <- function(truth_pos, score_pos) {
  truth_pos <- as.integer(truth_pos)
  score_pos <- as.numeric(score_pos)
  pos <- truth_pos == 1
  neg <- truth_pos == 0
  n_pos <- sum(pos)
  n_neg <- sum(neg)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_neg == 0) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(score_pos, ties.method = "average")
  (sum(r[pos]) - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2) / (n_pos * n_neg)
}

pr_curve_df <- function(truth_pos, score_pos) {
  ord <- order(score_pos, decreasing = TRUE)
  y <- as.integer(truth_pos[ord])
  s <- score_pos[ord]
  tp <- cumsum(y == 1)
  fp <- cumsum(y == 0)
  fn_total <- sum(y == 1)
  precision <- tp / pmax(tp + fp, 1)
  recall <- tp / pmax(fn_total, 1)
  tibble(threshold = s, precision = precision, recall = recall)
}

auc_pr <- function(truth_pos, score_pos) {
  df <- pr_curve_df(truth_pos, score_pos)
  if (nrow(df) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  # trapezoid on recall axis
  o <- order(df$recall, df$precision)
  x <- df$recall[o]
  y <- df$precision[o]
  sum(diff(x) * (head(y, -1) + tail(y, -1)) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

binary_metrics <- function(truth, pred, positive = "Normal") {
  # Drop incomplete pairs to avoid NA-driven logical errors
  keep <- !(is.na(truth) | is.na(pred))
  truth <- factor(as.character(truth[keep]))
  pred <- factor(as.character(pred[keep]), levels = levels(truth))
  if (length(truth) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      accuracy = NA_real_,
      balanced_accuracy = NA_real_,
      recall_normal = NA_real_,
      precision_normal = NA_real_,
      f1_normal = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  tp <- sum(truth == positive & pred == positive)
  fn <- sum(truth == positive & pred != positive)
  tn <- sum(truth != positive & pred != positive)
  fp <- sum(truth != positive & pred == positive)

  recall_pos <- if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn)
  precision_pos <- if ((tp + fp) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fp)
  f1_pos <- if (is.na(recall_pos) || is.na(precision_pos) || (recall_pos + precision_pos) == 0) NA_real_ else {
    2 * recall_pos * precision_pos / (recall_pos + precision_pos)
  }
  specificity <- if ((tn + fp) == 0) NA_real_ else tn / (tn + fp)
  bal_acc <- mean(c(recall_pos, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  acc <- mean(truth == pred)

  tibble(
    accuracy = acc,
    balanced_accuracy = bal_acc,
    recall_normal = recall_pos,
    precision_normal = precision_pos,
    f1_normal = f1_pos
  )
}

best_threshold_f1 <- function(truth, score_pos, positive = "Normal") {
  truth <- as.character(truth)
  neg <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(truth)), positive)[1]
  if (is.na(neg) || length(neg) == 0) return(0.5)
  cand <- sort(unique(score_pos))
  if (length(cand) > 200) cand <- quantile(cand, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1 <- sapply(cand, function(t) {
    pred <- ifelse(score_pos >= t, positive, neg)
    m <- binary_metrics(truth, pred, positive = positive)
    m$f1_normal
  })
  cand[which.max(f1)]
}

run_repeated_cv_binary <- function(X, y, K = 4, repeats = 20, positive = "Normal") {
  y <- factor(y)
  n <- nrow(X)

  perf <- data.frame()
  all_preds <- data.frame()
  all_scores <- data.frame()

  for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
    folds <- make_stratified_folds(y, K = K)
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      test_id <- folds[[k]]
      train_id <- setdiff(seq_len(n), test_id)

      X_train <- X[train_id, , drop = FALSE]
      X_test  <- X[test_id, , drop = FALSE]
      y_train <- y[train_id]
      y_test  <- y[test_id]

      imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
      X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
      X_test_i  <- impute_apply(X_test, imp)

      sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
      X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
      X_test_s  <- standardize_apply(X_test_i, sc)

      # Class imbalance weight
      n_pos <- sum(y_train == positive)
      n_neg <- sum(y_train != positive)
      pos_w <- if (n_pos > 0) n_neg / n_pos else 1
      neg_label <- setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1]
      cw <- c()
      cw[positive] <- pos_w
      cw[neg_label] <- 1

      # ---- kNN (baseline, unweighted) ----
      pred_knn <- class::knn(train = X_train_s, test = X_test_s, cl = y_train, k = 7, prob = TRUE)
      win_prob <- attr(pred_knn, "prob")
      score_knn <- ifelse(pred_knn == positive, win_prob, 1 - win_prob)
      m_knn <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_knn, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, m_knn))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_knn))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=score_knn))

      # ---- weighted SVM ----
      svm_fit <- e1071::svm(
        x = X_train_s, y = y_train, kernel = "radial",
        cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_train_s),
        class.weights = cw, probability = TRUE
      )
      pred_svm <- predict(svm_fit, X_test_s, probability = TRUE)
      prob_svm <- attr(pred_svm, "probabilities")
      score_svm <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_svm)) prob_svm[, "Normal"] else prob_svm[, 1]
      m_svm <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_svm, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary", model="SVM_RBF_w", rep=r, fold=k, m_svm))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary", model="SVM_RBF_w", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_svm))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary", model="SVM_RBF_w", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=score_svm))

      # ---- weighted RF ----
      rf_fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_train_i, y = y_train, classwt = cw)
      pred_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i)
      prob_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i, type = "prob")
      score_rf <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_rf)) prob_rf[, "Normal"] else prob_rf[, 1]
      m_rf <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_rf, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary", model="RF_w", rep=r, fold=k, m_rf))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary", model="RF_w", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_rf))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary", model="RF_w", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=score_rf))

      # ---- weighted logistic regression ----
      w <- ifelse(y_train == positive, pos_w, 1)
      glm_fit <- glm(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s), family = binomial(), weights = w)
      p_hat <- predict(glm_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s), type = "response")
      pred_glm <- ifelse(p_hat >= 0.5, positive, setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1])
      pred_glm <- factor(pred_glm, levels = levels(y_train))
      m_glm <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_glm, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary", model="Logistic_w", rep=r, fold=k, m_glm))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary", model="Logistic_w", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_glm))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary", model="Logistic_w", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=p_hat))
    }
  }

  list(perf = perf, preds = all_preds, scores = all_scores)
}
```

```{r, fig.cap="Binary: pooled ROC and PR curves for the best model."}
  fp <- sum(pred & truth01 == 0)
  tn <- sum(!pred & truth01 == 0)
  tibble(
    threshold = t,
    tpr = if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn),
    fpr = if ((fp + tn) == 0) NA_real_ else fp / (fp + tn)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
run_repeated_cv_binary_unweighted <- function(X, y, K = 4, repeats = 20, positive = "Normal") {
  y <- factor(y)
  n <- nrow(X)

  perf <- data.frame()
  all_preds <- data.frame()
  all_scores <- data.frame()

  for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
    folds <- make_stratified_folds(y, K = K)
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      test_id <- folds[[k]]
      train_id <- setdiff(seq_len(n), test_id)

      X_train <- X[train_id, , drop = FALSE]
      X_test  <- X[test_id, , drop = FALSE]
      y_train <- y[train_id]
      y_test  <- y[test_id]

      imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
      X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
      X_test_i  <- impute_apply(X_test, imp)

      sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
      X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
      X_test_s  <- standardize_apply(X_test_i, sc)

      # ---- kNN ----
      pred_knn <- class::knn(train = X_train_s, test = X_test_s, cl = y_train, k = 7, prob = TRUE)
      win_prob <- attr(pred_knn, "prob")
      score_knn <- ifelse(pred_knn == positive, win_prob, 1 - win_prob)
      m_knn <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_knn, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, m_knn))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_knn))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="kNN", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=score_knn))

      # ---- SVM (unweighted) ----
      svm_fit <- e1071::svm(x = X_train_s, y = y_train, kernel = "radial", cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_train_s), probability = TRUE)
      pred_svm <- predict(svm_fit, X_test_s, probability = TRUE)
      prob_svm <- attr(pred_svm, "probabilities")
      score_svm <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_svm)) prob_svm[, "Normal"] else prob_svm[, 1]
      m_svm <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_svm, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="SVM_RBF", rep=r, fold=k, m_svm))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="SVM_RBF", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_svm))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="SVM_RBF", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=score_svm))

      # ---- RF (unweighted) ----
      rf_fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_train_i, y = y_train)
      pred_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i)
      prob_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i, type = "prob")
      score_rf <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_rf)) prob_rf[, "Normal"] else prob_rf[, 1]
      m_rf <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_rf, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="RF", rep=r, fold=k, m_rf))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="RF", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_rf))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="RF", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=score_rf))

      # ---- Logistic regression (unweighted) ----
      glm_fit <- glm(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s), family = binomial())
      p_hat <- predict(glm_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s), type = "response")
      pred_glm <- ifelse(p_hat >= 0.5, positive, setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1])
      pred_glm <- factor(pred_glm, levels = levels(y_train))
      m_glm <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_glm, positive = positive)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="Logistic", rep=r, fold=k, m_glm))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="Logistic", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, pred=pred_glm))
      all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task="binary_unw", model="Logistic", rep=r, fold=k, truth=y_test, score_normal=p_hat))
    }
  }

  list(perf = perf, preds = all_preds, scores = all_scores)
}
```
